items.heading: Strip Away the Job Title
items.text: Strip away the job title and the role is straightforward: understand where someone actually stands, their interests, strengths, academic or work history, and the real constraints around them (money, timing, family expectations), then apply that understanding to one specific decision in front of them. The result should be a direct recommendation, not a diagnosis that stops at a label.

items.heading: Before Booking a Paid Conversation
items.text: Before booking a paid conversation with anyone, it's worth knowing what a genuine session actually involves, so you can tell a real one apart from a rushed or scripted one.

items.heading: The Role Is Delivered Through
items.text: The role is delivered through a few different channels, and they are not interchangeable in terms of time, cost, or how personal the conversation gets.

items.heading: The Job Is to Move
items.text: The job is to move you from a confusing set of options to one specific, actionable recommendation, not to hand you a personality label.

items.heading: A School Counselling Cell,
items.text: A school counselling cell, a private independent counselor, and an online session are three different ways to reach the same role, none is automatically the right one for everyone.

items.heading: The Person Matters More Than
items.text: The person matters more than the credential on their profile, see the dedicated checklist below for judging a specific counselor.
